message: depcurfew 99.0.0 is pinned in .claude/depcurfew/package-lock.json, but the depcurfew running this check is older, so it may not know settings that version writes or checks
fix: Install it in .claude/depcurfew (cd .claude/depcurfew && npm ci --ignore-scripts), then run that copy (node .claude/depcurfew/node_modules/depcurfew/dist/cli.js doctor), or update the depcurfew you run to 99.0.0 or later
